item.title: Version 1.324.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.324.0

Added

  • Refresh a brand from its website — if your site's logo or colours changed, choose Refresh from your site in the brand's menu in Settings ▸ Brand. You see the brand before and after, and pick what to take. Anything you changed by hand, like its name or look, stays as you made it. Every Recording and Template that uses the brand updates too, keeping its own words and settings.
  • Every slide can move now, not only the frame — the Look tab has a Motion row in place of Assemble on Open. Pick Assemble, Sweep, Drift, Hand-off or Cut, and the intro and chapter slides build themselves the same way, their logo, words and lines arriving one after another. To change one slide on its own, use the small mark on its block in the timeline.
  • Your logo can sit in a corner of every frame — turn on Logo on every frame under your brand in the Look tab. Your brand's logo shows in the bottom right of your video, or the corner you pick, at the size you pick. It is in the saved video exactly where you see it in the editor.
  • Space plays and pauses — in the editor, press Space to play your video and again to pause it, as in other video editors. It doesn't get in the way when you type a title or a caption. The hints under the timeline now list it.

Changed

  • The timeline waits for what you add — each planned Section now waits on the video row as a dashed block with a red record dot, right under its name. Click it to record that Section, or click New Section at the end for one you didn't plan. Pictures and videos over your video go on the Layers row: point at the timeline and it opens, then click where the picture should start.

item.title: Version 1.319.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.319.0

Added

  • Your brand's frame can build itself as the video starts — turn on Assemble on Open in the Look tab. The side panel slides in, the words drop in from the top and your video slides in from the side. It is over in under a second, then the frame holds still.

Fixed

  • Broadcast's intro shows your video in the saved file — the saved video was black behind the intro's name bar, and behind each chapter's bar. Now your video shows through, as it does in the editor.
  • Poster's frame no longer says "2" — a big "2" stood in the corner of every Section of every video. It is gone, and your picture sits in the middle of the frame.
  • Poster's Two Colours is easier to read on a bright site — the big name and address were dark amber on amber. They are darker now, so they stand out on a phone.

item.title: Version 1.316.1
item.description:
What's New in 1.316.1

Changed

  • Make a Loop shows what you made — a step you pick now opens once its rings and words are showing. Zoom waits for you to drag before it zooms, and a step's edges are easier to see and grab.

item.title: Version 1.316.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.316.0

Added

  • Auto-Edit cuts your restarts — press Auto-Edit and the false starts come out, each striped on the timeline until you keep or cut it. Undo puts back restarts, ums or pauses on their own or all at once.
  • Templates for your brand — pick one of five looks in the Look tab to put an intro, chapter slides, a frame and an end card on your video in your colours at once.
  • Crop each Section on its own — turn on "Crop each Section separately" under Crop in the Video tab, and the crop changes only the Section under the playhead.

Changed

  • Make a Loop is calmer, and has undo — the picture comes first, and you add zooms, rings, arrows and words right on it. Drag a step's edge or click in the strip to move through it, and undo any change.
  • Rename a Section where you type its title — the name you type in the Text tab now shows on the timeline, the clip and the picture.
  • Section arrows only where there is something to open — the arrow beside a Section in the Text tab now appears only when it has caption lines to show.
  • A simpler Save Video — it opens on just the file's name, its folder and its size; quality, shapes and subtitles are under Options.

Fixed

  • Ums are cut even with captions off — every new take now loses its ums, with or without captions.
  • Going Home no longer stops the tidy-up — a new take is tidied and checked for private text even if you leave the editor straight away.
  • Rings in Make a Loop stay where you put them — a ring no longer splits its step, and rings and the zoom box follow the pointer as you drag.
  • Titles you typed before show on the timeline — a Section titled in an earlier version now shows that title on the timeline and its clip.
  • Full-screen windows can be recorded — a window that is full screen in its own Space is now offered in the New Recording window.
  • A hidden window says so — a window Stage Manager keeps out of sight now says it is hidden and how to bring it up, instead of waiting forever.
  • Loops keep what a newer version added — an older copy of Prodoozie no longer drops parts of a loop a newer one added.
  • The right window is picked for you — when your last window is closed, the New Recording window now picks that app's biggest window, never a tiny one.

item.title: Version 1.315.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.315.0

Added

  • Your brand on your videos — make a brand from your website in Settings → Brand, and Prodoozie takes your colours, logo and address from it. Pick it in the Look tab to put a heading, a footer and a ring around the picture, and press Add End Card in the Text tab to end on a card with your address. Each Recording keeps its own copy, so changing a brand later never changes a video you already made.

Changed

  • A new icon — the leopard's eye now looks out of an open clapperboard, in the Dock and in the menu bar. While you record, the eye in the menu bar opens into a red dot.

Fixed

  • Window recordings are sharp again with Stage Manager on — a window picked from the side strip was recorded at the size of its little preview, so the video came out tiny and blurry. Prodoozie now records the window at its real size.

item.title: Version 1.293.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.293.0

Added

  • Add a video file to a Recording — press Add Video or Image… beside Record next section, right-click the timeline and choose Add Video or Image Here…, pick File ▸ Add Video or Image…, or just drop a video onto the timeline, and it becomes a Section of its own. Prodoozie copies it into the Recording and turns a phone's tall video the right way up, and a clip of another shape sits inside the frame without being squashed. Captions come only from a microphone track, so a phone video's sound plays but gets no captions.
  • Add a picture or a GIF the same way — the same buttons, and a drop onto the timeline, take a picture or a GIF too, and each becomes a Section of its own. A picture shows for five seconds, and you can drag its end out to a full minute to talk over it. A GIF that loops plays for at least three seconds, so a short one isn't gone in a blink. Anything see-through in them shows as black, and Prodoozie tells you when that happens.
  • Section titles — tick Section Titles in the editor's Text tab to put each Section's name on the video for its first four seconds. A Section you haven't named gets no title, and the title sits above your captions, so they never move.
  • Style your Section titles — choose a dark, light or colored box, or no box at all, and a font and size. A colored box can match your background. Prodoozie picks white or black words for you, so a title is always easy to read on its box.
  • Make a loop for your web page — the new loop button beside Poster frame turns your Recording into a short, silent video that plays on repeat. Pick the moments, speed them up, zoom in, ring what matters and add a label, and watch it play as it will on the page. Saving gives you the video, a picture to show before it plays, and code to paste into your site, and anything you hid stays hidden.
  • Private text is hidden for you — when you stop, Prodoozie reads the new take on your Mac and hides people's names, email addresses, card numbers, keys, links and other text that looks private. The editor says what it hid, and you can show any kind again with one click. Only what's inside your windows is hidden: the menu bar, the Dock and the desktop are left alone. It can miss things, so look before you share. If a take can't be checked, the editor and Save Video tell you. You can turn it off in Settings → Recording.

Changed

  • iRecord is now Prodoozie — the app has a new name, and that is all that changed. Your Recordings, your licence and the permissions you gave all carry over, so there is nothing to do. The app in your Applications folder may still be called iRecord after this update; it is the same app and keeps updating.
  • Hidden areas are blurred, not black — a black box over a page looked like something broke. Anything new you hide, or that Prodoozie hides for you, is now a soft blur in the colours around it. The blur keeps nothing of what was under it, so it can't be undone. Areas you hid before stay as they were, and you can still choose solid or pixelate.
  • The editor shows one thing at a time — the panel beside the video has a row of tabs, one for each part of your video: Look, Camera, Sections, Video, Zoom, Text and Hidden. Click the camera, a caption or a clip and the panel shows what you can change about it; click an empty spot to change the background. The timeline names its rows, the sound has a row of its own that always moves with its picture, and a row appears only when it has something in it. Section titles are switched on in Text.
  • A roomier editor — the timeline's rows are taller with space between them, and its words and times are bigger and easier to read. Opening a Recording makes a small window bigger so the editor has room, and a new install opens at most of your screen.
  • Cursor Zoom no longer offers Manual regions — picking it never zoomed anything: it turned the zoom off while the switch stayed on. It is gone from the list. A Recording already set to it shows Manual (zooms nothing) until you pick another mode, and saves the same video as before.

Fixed

  • Report an Issue reaches us again — it started an email to an old address that no longer gets mail. It now goes to support@mail.prodoozie.com.
  • A recording that stops suddenly keeps what was recorded — if a microphone went quiet for a few seconds, or System Audio was off, a recording cut short by a crash or a forced quit could come back empty. Now it comes back up to the last few seconds, and "saved through" on the recording indicator shows only what is really safe.
  • A new plan starts at its first Section — planning a new Series left an empty Section 1 in front of your plan, so the header counted one Section too many and Record next section opened on the empty one. Your plan now takes its place.
  • A plan fits on the timeline before you record — until something was recorded, the timeline showed only the start of your first planned Section, and zooming out did nothing. Now the whole plan is on screen, and Zoom and Fit work.
  • A take that couldn't be saved is no longer forgotten — if Prodoozie stopped in the middle of a take before any of it was safely written, the next launch said nothing about it. Now it tells you which Recording and Section the take was in, so you know to record it again.
  • Clicks in Prodoozie's own windows are recorded — when you recorded Prodoozie itself, your clicks in its windows were not saved, so Cursor Zoom set to On click never zoomed in on them. They are saved now, and a click made while Prodoozie was busy is no longer missed.
